notes: U1 shirt->shirt recolour replaced by a hoodie; U4 dangling 'its neck' removed and, since the dog already wears a red vest and red neck item, payload changed to a party hat. U2/U3 unchanged.

units.instruction_ref_zh: 将横幅旁步行者的白色polo衫替换为一件红色拉链连帽衫。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一件红色拉链连帽衫。
units.reason: Polo -> polo of another colour is a recolour; a zip-up hoodie is a garment-type change.

units.instruction_ref_zh: 给右侧的大棕狗戴上一顶黄色小派对帽。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一顶黄色小派对帽。
units.reason: Payload had a dangling 'its neck'; clean crop shows the dog already wears a red vest and red item at the neck, so a neck bandana is near-duplicate. A party hat on the dog is self-contained; mask stays the dog (anchor).
